module: Powertrain component `compressor`: pneumatic air compressor (air brakes, air suspension of trucks). It is a torque consumer without an output port (leaf of the powertrain tree): it receives the speed of its parent, pumps air into a registered `pressureTank` tank (energyStorage) and returns a resisting torque `torqueDiff` to its parent. It disengages (deload) above the cut-out pressure and re-engages below the cut-in pressure. It plays compressor and purge sounds, and sends data to the GUI stream 'pneumaticsData'.
usage:
local comp = powertrain.getDevice("airCompressor")
print(comp.engaged, comp.pumpPressure, comp.pumpedAirFlow) -- bool, Pa, m^3/s
notes: Jbeam keys read: name, type, inputName, inputIndex, gearRatio (1), friction, dynamicFriction, electricsName, visualShaftAVName, node, requiredEnergyType ('air'), energyStorage, pumpDisplacement (m³ per revolution, default 0.00035), pumpEfficiency (0.8), cutOutPressure (relative Pa, 900000), cutInPressure (80 % of cutOutPressure), motorThrottleElectricsName (name + 'Throttle', unused in this file), deloadWhenDisengaged (true), breakTriggerBeam, and for the sounds: purgeSoundNode, pumpPurgeEvent, purgeSoundVolume (0.5), compressorSoundNode, compressorLoopEvent, compressorSoundVolume (0.5).

Main fields: inputAV (rad/s, = parent speed), torqueDiff (N·m, resisting torque returned to the parent), pumpedAirFlow (m³/s), pumpedEnergy (J added to the tank this step), pumpPressure (relative Pa), engaged (true if the compressor is charging), deloadCoef (0 = loaded, 1 = unloaded), pressureTank (storage of type pressureTank or nil), cumulativeInertia (virtualInertia = 1 kg·m² scaled by gearRatio²), isBroken.

The game engine must know the categories: the compressor is declared clutchlike, clutch, pneumaticPowerSource and torqueConsumer. It has no output port (outputPorts = {}), but outputTorque1/outputAV1 exist at 0.
The tank pressures are absolute in pressureTank.currentPressure; engaged/cutOut/cutIn use the relative pressure (current - powertrain.currentEnvPressure).

Inconsistencies: updateVelocity rewrites parent[parentOutputAVName] = inputAV with the value it has just read (no effect); applyDeformGroupDamage and selectUpdates (isBroken case) are empty; a broken compressor keeps working. M.requiredExternalInertiaOutputs is not defined in this module.

new.desc: Builds the compressor: displacement (pumpDisplacement), efficiency, cut-out/cut-in pressures, mode and output names.

velocityUpdate.desc: Called at each physics step: reads inputAV from the parent, computes the air flow (max(0, inputAV/(2π) * pumpDisplacement * pumpEfficiency * (1 - deloadCoef))), adds the pumped energy to the tank, handles engaging/unloading according to the cut-out pressures (plays the purge sound on unloading) and computes pumpPressure.

torqueUpdate.desc: Called at each physics step: torqueDiff = pumpPressure * pumpDisplacement / (2π) if inputAV > 0, otherwise 0 (resisting torque of the compressor).

updateGFX.desc: Per-frame update: sends the tank pressure (relative kPa) and the state 'Engaged' or 'Disengaged' to the GUI stream 'pneumaticsData', only if the stream is requested.

updateSounds.desc: Sets the volume (according to inputAV from 10 to 20 rad/s), the pitch (smoothed RPM) and the color (1 - deloadCoef) of the compressor sound.

setPartCondition.desc: Applies isBroken from the integrity (number: not broken; table: isBroken field) by calling onBreak if needed.

getPartCondition.desc: Returns 1 (0 if broken) and the table {isBroken}.

validate.desc: Called after the powertrain is built; always returns true.

onBreak.desc: Sets isBroken = true (with no other real effect because selectUpdates is empty in this case).

registerStorage.desc: Registers an air tank: the storage must be of type pressureTank and of the same energyType as requiredEnergyType, otherwise an error is logged. Stores the tank in pressureTank.

calculateInertia.desc: Purely virtual inertia: cumulativeInertia = virtualInertia / gearRatio²; cumulative ratios = gearRatio.

initSounds.desc: Creates the compressor sound loop (started at volume 0), reads the sound nodes and events from the jbeam (by default the parent's engine node) and creates the pitch smoother.

reset.desc: Resets speeds, pressure, flow and pumped energy, wear/damage coefficients, deloadCoef = 1 and the sound smoother; rereads gearRatio and friction.
